title: The Sea of Glass
lead: Under God's feet at Sinai the elders saw "what looked like a floor of blue lapis stone, as pure as the sky itself" (Exodus 24:10). Ezekiel sees a sparkling crystal expanse above the living creatures (Ezekiel 1:22), and Revelation a sea of glass like crystal before the throne (Revelation 4:6; 15:2). The temple's bronze "sea" (1 Kings 7:23) may stand behind the picture.
